scientific_integrity: Mathematical proof and independent-formula numerical checks included. Prior same-ensemble results are distinguished from newly derived all-field support and coefficient asymptotics. No independent audit or certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: The field order is fixed and sampling is uniform over labeled monomial structure matrices. General cycle-factor laws, moment generating functions and the q=4 special case were already known. The all-field sharp rare-event asymptotic is a nontrivial but natural extension of these prior finite formulas, and comprehensive publication priority remains unresolved. Finite verification does not establish the infinite asymptotic theorem.
title: Arithmetic support and sharp rare-idempotent asymptotics in monomial evolution algebras
